name: Devin Gallemore

experience.title: Sr AVP — Quantitative Model Solutions Specialist
experience.summary: Building agentic investigation workflows and applied machine-learning systems, with experience in anomaly detection, rates research, and model reliability.

Automate interest-rate analytics and prototype regime-aware anomaly research using economic data and statistical methods.
Design regression testing and monitoring for enterprise liquidity forecasting, cash-flow variances, and upstream data quality.

Delivered scenario analysis to senior stakeholders and built Python/Unix automation for production forecasting workflows.
